Title: Azure Service Health preview: New health alert creation and management

Body.Content:
Azure Service Health preview has added a Health Alerts feature. With this feature, you can stay up to date on service issues, planned maintenance, and health advisories in Azure that might affect your resources. You can easily create new alerts for service issue events based on your pre-existing filters, manage your service health alerts, and find relevant information like the history of past alerts.

 

Check out and set up your personalized alerts in Service Health on the Azure portal.
